selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before any change (cron service, existing allow/deny, users)
selected_evidence.summary: crond active, no cron.allow/cron.deny present, no non-system users, opsadmin absent before configuration

selected_evidence.requirement: Only root and opsadmin permitted to schedule cron jobs (creation of opsadmin, cron.allow content, and functional enforcement)
selected_evidence.summary: opsadmin created; /etc/cron.allow set to root+opsadmin; direct crontab invocation as a non-listed user (cronprobe2) denied with 'not allowed to use this program'; cron.deny removed; test artifacts cleaned up

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart baseline capture of boot identity and re-confirmed enforcement immediately before reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 1b0321bf-2638-4d27-bc00-5bd01dce8e0b, cron.allow=root/opsadmin, crond active, and denial for non-listed user 'precheck', then cleaned up precheck

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, exactly one node restarted
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued on node1 returning exit_code 0 before the connection was reset, confirming the disconnect happened only after acknowledgement

selected_evidence.requirement: Node reachable again after restart and boot identity changed
selected_evidence.summary: exec succeeded again on node1; boot_id changed to 74214009-0928-4957-b63d-f648773ec5ef, proving an actual reboot occurred, with uptime showing a fresh boot time

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service/state: crond active, cron.allow intact, enforcement still correct
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot: crond active, /etc/cron.allow still root+opsadmin, cron.deny absent, non-listed user 'postcheck' denied crontab use, opsadmin able to install/list a crontab entry; test artifacts cleaned up leaving final clean state

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id =="; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== cron service =="; systemctl is-active crond || true
echo "== existing cron.allow =="; cat /etc/cron.allow 2>/dev/null || echo "NOT PRESENT"
echo "== existing cron.deny =="; cat /etc/cron.deny 2>/dev/null || echo "NOT PRESENT"
echo "== opsadmin user =="; id opsadmin 2>/dev/null || echo "NOT PRESENT"
echo "== root user =="; id root
echo "== users with crontabs =="; ls /var/spool/cron/ 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create opsadmin =="
sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash opsadmin
echo "== create throwaway test user =="
sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash cronprobe

echo "== configure cron.allow =="
printf 'root\nopsadmin\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/cron.allow >/dev/null
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/cron.allow
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.allow
echo "cron.allow contents:"
cat /etc/cron.allow

echo "== remove cron.deny to avoid ambiguity (cron.allow takes precedence anyway) =="
sudo -n rm -f /etc/cron.deny

echo "== verify: root can install a crontab =="
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u root -'
sudo -n crontab -u root -l

echo "== verify: opsadmin can install a crontab =="
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u opsadmin -'
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -l

echo "== verify: cronprobe is denied =="
set +e
sudo -n bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -u cronprobe -' 2>&1
echo "cronprobe crontab exit code: $?"
set -e

echo "== cleanup opsadmin/root test crontabs =="
sudo -n crontab -u root -r
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -r

echo "== remove throwaway test user =="
sudo -n userdel -r cronprobe

commands.command:

echo "== attempt as cronprobe2 itself (not via -u) =="

sudo -n -u cronprobe2 bash -c 'echo "* * * * * /bin/true" | crontab -' 
echo "exit: $?"
sudo -n -u cronprobe2 crontab -l
echo "list exit: $?"
set -e
echo "== spool dir =="

sudo -n userdel -r cronprobe2

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== kill leftover processes for cronprobe2 =="
sudo -n pkill -u cronprobe2 || true
sleep 1
sudo -n userdel -r cronprobe2 2>&1 || sudo -n userdel -f -r cronprobe2 2>&1 || true
echo "== remove stray crontab file for old cronprobe (user already deleted) =="
sudo -n rm -f /var/spool/cron/cronprobe
echo "== final spool listing =="
ls -la /var/spool/cron/ 2>/dev/null || true
echo "== confirm opsadmin/root exist, cronprobe gone =="
id opsadmin
id root
id cronprobe 2>&1 || true
id cronprobe2 2>&1 || true
echo "== final cron.allow / cron.deny state =="
cat /etc/cron.allow
test -f /etc/cron.deny && echo "cron.deny still present" || echo "cron.deny absent (expected)"
echo "== root crontab currently empty (expected, we removed test entry) =="
sudo -n crontab -u root -l 2>&1 || true
sudo -n crontab -u opsadmin -l 2>&1 || true
systemctl is-active crond
